note: typhoon_signal in the dataset is 0-4 (same scale as the wind_to_signal() thresholds in the API backend, so no remapping is needed). prev_flood is EXCLUDED from future_feature_order because it isn't known in advance. enriched_features_used (if any) must also be fetched by app/features/engineering.py from the live Open-Meteo call -- that's what links the training dataset to the live inference features.

reliability.measured_on: held-out test split (20% of sequential data, never seen in training)
reliability.honest_caveat: Metrics beyond ~day 7-10 also inherit Open-Meteo's own forecast uncertainty at longer lead times, on top of the model's own error -- treat flood_probability as decision-support, not a certainty score.
